stories.title: Eminevim 600 bininci teslimatını yaptı: 9 ayda 190 bini aşkın teslimat

en.title: Eminevim completes 600 millionth delivery: over 190 million deliveries in 9 months
en.summary: Eminevim, a savings financing company, announced it became the first company in its sector to reach 600 million deliveries. The company completed over 190 million deliveries in the first nine months of 2026.

stories.title: Deprem bölgesindeki elektrik şirketlerine ödeme kolaylığı

en.title: Payment facilities provided to electricity companies in earthquake zone
en.summary: Electric distribution companies operating in four earthquake-affected regions received advance payment facilities throughout 2027. The regulatory decision defers supplier payments to invoice due dates while consumer bills remain unaffected.

stories.title: Dünyaca ünlü Strauss Philharmonie Türkiye'ye geliyor! Ankara ve İstanbul'da iki konser

en.title: World-renowned Strauss Philharmonie coming to Turkey! Two concerts in Ankara and Istanbul
en.summary: The Strauss Philharmonie from Vienna will perform on October 12, 2026 in Ankara and October 13 in Istanbul. The concert will feature 15 musicians and a soprano performing works by Johann Strauss, Mozart, Kálmán, Fučík, and Lehár.

stories.title: Diyarbakır Kültür Yolu Festivali başladı! 9 günde 249 etkinlik ve ücretsiz konserler

en.title: Diyarbakır Culture Road Festival begins! 249 events and free concerts in 9 days
en.summary: The Diyarbakır Culture Road Festival runs October 10-18, 2026 with 249 events across 14 venues. Artists including Hakan Altun, Mert Demir, Sefo, and Murat Boz will perform free concerts, with 48 food points also available.

stories.title: Dev fondan kritik uyarı: ABD tahvil faizleri yüzde 6'ya çıkabilir

en.title: Critical warning from major fund: US bond yields could reach 6 percent
en.summary: PIMCO, one of the world's largest bond managers, has flagged the possibility of US 10-year bond yields reaching 6 percent. The firm also warned that risks for equities and corporate bonds could materialize at lower levels.
